source_provider: nLine PowerWatch organization 2, Grafana Timescale datasource
scope: bounded installation-week measurements, dated deployment metadata and current-week export; not continuous coverage audit

history_attempts.scope: all-history, bounded full-span and recent-period extrema
history_attempts.result: three 502 server timeouts; no long-span rows used

timestamp_note: measurement timestamps are timezone-aware UTC; deployment times are source timezone-naive and retained without assuming a zone

exports.query: deployment_pwdata, Ndosho/ARE-Virunga/Hopital Provincial; public projection retains only Ndosho rows
deployment-valid particle observations; COUNT(*) and distinct 120s time_bucket; no voltage >-0.5 filter
